components.css: .ds-evidence{padding:30px 32px 8px;background:var(--color-base-200,#e5eadf);color:var(--ink,#202c26);font-family:"Public Sans Variable",sans-serif}.ds-evidence:before{content:"";display:block;width:54px;height:3px;background:var(--accent,#335c45);margin-bottom:22px;transform-origin:left;animation:ds-rule 700ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}.ds-evidence h2{font:600 27px/1.25 "Manrope Variable",sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin:0 0 23px}.ds-evidence a{display:block;position:relative;padding:18px 28px 20px 0;border-top:1px solid #b8c3b3;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;transition:color 160ms ease-out}.ds-company{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;color:#4b5e4d;margin-bottom:4px}.ds-evidence strong{display:block;font-size:15px;line-height:1.4;font-weight:600}.ds-evidence small{display:block;margin-top:7px;font-size:12px;color:#4b5e4d}.ds-evidence svg{position:absolute;right:0;top:38px;width:18px;height:18px;transition:transform 160ms ease-out}.ds-evidence a:hover{color:var(--accent,#335c45)}.ds-evidence a:hover svg{transform:translate(2px,2px)}.ds-evidence a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#335c45);outline-offset:5px} @keyframes ds-rule{from{transform:scaleX(.2)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}} @media(max-width:1050px){.ds-evidence{padding-inline:24px}} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-evidence:before{animation:none}.ds-evidence a,.ds-evidence svg{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
Engineering dossier: warm paper, forest ink, measured typography, and open ruled rows. The system gives professional evidence enough structure to scan without turning each fact into a floating card.

This reference applies only to the homepage rendered by `src/layouts/HomeLayout.astro`. The CV and LaterTabs routes retain independent styles. The source of truth is `src/styles/home.css`; the approved surface composition lives in [.impeccable/surfaces/src-pages-index-astro.md](.impeccable/surfaces/src-pages-index-astro.md).
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral canvas with a restrained forest accent.
Manrope headings paired with Public Sans reading text.
Open ruled evidence, compact controls, and native anchor navigation.

rules.name: The Evidence Field Rule
rules.body: Use the pale green field to group linked professional evidence; keep career entries on the paper canvas, separated by rules.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Manrope for headings and the identity mark; use Public Sans for prose, metadata, navigation, and actions.

rules.name: The Screenshot Lift Rule
rules.body: Reserve the soft shadow for the actual product screenshot; editorial rows and evidence fields remain flat.

dos: Do reuse the homepage tokens and preserve the separate CV and LaterTabs styling boundaries.
Do keep actions readable, with visible focus and at least the existing 44px link or 48px button target height.
Do use real product imagery and record its provenance.
Do preserve native anchors and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't apply this homepage system to the CV or LaterTabs routes without a separate decision.
Don't replace open ruled rows with a repeated floating-card treatment.
Don't use the product screenshot shadow on ordinary text containers.
